integrity: The derivation uses the source kernel area identity, strict positivity and center value, Harnack and Schwarz inequalities, entropy differentiation and exact normalized radial integration. Direct numerical sampling is illustrative only.
scientific_limitations: The new quantitative content is the r>2 coefficient and Hardy--Dirichlet derivative bound for polynomials with simple unimodular zeros; no optimality or arbitrary-multiplicity quantitative bound is asserted. All-exponent strictness and the r<=2 coefficient bound were previously published.
source_ids: Strict Baernstein monotonicity and quantitative binomial rigidity (published 2026)
title: An all-exponent Hardy--Dirichlet gap in Baernstein quasi-norm comparison
